release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.4.3 Directional Elongation & Material Takeoffs, Slab Rate Controls & Chair Summary CAD Toggle:
• Directional Takeoff Subtotals (X/Y & Longitude/Latitude): Both CAD drawing sheets and Excel cutting length schedules now display detailed directional totals directly below each table for Total Strands, Anchors, and Wedges.
• Combined Longitude & Latitude Grand Totals: Comprehensive grand total summary blocks across all axes in CAD and Excel, including directional side-by-side comparison matrices.
• Optional Slab Area & PT Rate Export: User setting in CAD export dialog, CAD settings dialog, and Excel to toggle slab area, PT rates (kg/m² and m²/ton), tendon rates, and slab schedules on or off.
• CAD Chair Summary Table Toggle: User switch in CAD export dialog and settings dialog to toggle whether Chair Summary Tables are drawn on CAD drawing sheets.
